title: Source decision input
description: Language-neutral input envelope for the shared operating-decision core.

decision_context.description: Optional independently admitted material decision context; absent or unrelated input remains quiet.

intent.description: Explicit task intent supplied by the acting agent or human rather than inferred by the reducer.

current_work.description: Current task identity used only to reject a stale semantic-route selection.

semantic_route_source.description: Current repo-owned semantic-route identities and their source revision.

semantic_task_routes.description: Acting-agent selection bound to the current task and route-source revisions.

public_request.description: One typed source-owner intention selected by an agent or human and bound to current task and capability revisions.

outcome.description: Exact outcome authority required before the task may be terminal.

required_claims.description: Outcome-owner-declared claims that must be currently allowed before completion; absence of their owner or evidence does not waive them.

owner.description: Owner authorized to establish the intended outcome.

claim.description: Claim that must be allowed for terminal status.

capability_contract.description: Current declarative ownership and constructibility authority for any authority-bearing contribution or public request.

contributions.description: Current source-owned contributions composed by the shared reducer.

readonly_handoff_inputs.description: Current acting-agent completeness judgment for necessary read-only assignment inputs; source readability/currentness is observed separately.

readonly_handoff_export.description: Read-only export of one current comparative assignment.

readonly_handoff_return.description: Structured read-only worker observation; never proof, authenticated review or completion.

assignment_comparative_judgment.description: One current comparative execution assessment by the acting orchestrator; never a persistent preference, capability observation or proof.

execution_configuration_choice.description: Current feasible execution configuration choice; neither assignment nor launch authority.

revision.description: Exact current execution configuration inventory revision.

candidate.description: Exact eligible configuration ID returned by the owner.

level.description: Agent-selected assurance guidance level, constrained by current source escalation permissions.

profile_ids.description: Additional known current proof profiles selected by the acting agent; cannot remove source-required profiles.

reason.description: Current task-specific strategy judgment, never proof or reviewer authentication.

verification_strategy_request.description: Current Verification strategy assessment bound by its public request to exact task, work, source and capability identities.

session_logging_policy_input.description: Maintainer logging policy over canonical local configuration and the existing process disable override; never workflow authority.

local.description: Current local source, separately validated against workspace_local_override.schema.json.

disable_override.description: Observed AW_SESSION_LOGGING_DISABLE value; exact 1 disables capture.

command.description: Exact source-declared command text, validated against the selected route before effects.

verification_execute_request.description: Choose one exact command already offered by the current Verification strategy; this request supplies no command or proof authority.

route_id.description: Reported route hint or unresolved; only matching current source declarations establish strategy coverage.

command.description: Bounded reported command text; retaining it does not authorize execution.

result.description: Reported result, not authenticated execution evidence.

reported_observation.description: Preserved interoperability receipt fields, unproven by native producer admission.

verification_record_request.description: Record an explicit interoperability observation against the exact current task and proof subject. The observation supplies no native execution, proof sufficiency or independent-review authority.

target.description: Current canonical repository root admitted by the host.

execute_selected.description: Explicitly selects the effectful execution and publication behavior of proof.report.

selection.description: Current owner-derived command, strategy, subject, work, runtime observations and bounded timeout; public clients cannot supply selection authority.

record_receipt.description: Publish the current owner-derived interoperability observation without executing a command.

native_proof_arguments.description: Owner-derived selected proof process and receipt publication effect, sealed to the current native subject and strategy.

proof_receipt_input.description: Existing deterministic proof receipt shape and binding checks. The timestamp observation is host-decoded timezone validity only; none of these operations authenticate a producer or establish freshness, coverage, task sufficiency or independence.

proof_subject_input.description: Deterministic proof identity operations. Host-observed runtime inputs never authenticate evidence or grant a claim.

direct_task_subject_input.description: Existing direct-task semantic subject inputs; no source admission or claim authority is supplied by this request.

verification_claim_request.description: Request current Verification judgment for an exact work-bound claim. Evidence references identify candidates; they do not authenticate producers or assert acceptance.

decision_dismissal.description: Trusted owner-admitted dismissal. A client-authored assertion cannot admit human or domain authority.

reason.description: Agent/human judgment explaining lack of future retention value.

authority.description: Independently admitted decisive authority for dismissal, not inferred from authorship.

decision_reconciliation.description: Bounded reconciliation facts, not capture UX, storage or mutation authority.

residue.description: Explicit agent/human-selected future-value residue; every item receives an outcome or pending route.

native_owner.description: Independently configured/discovered repo-native durable owner, or admitted absence.

fallback_owner.description: Existing admitted AW fallback durable owner used only when native owner is absent.

items.description: Exact durable owner admission of the same material decision.

destinations.description: Independent destination evidence, rechecked against current source observations.

dismissals.description: Explicit judgments, each bound to decision revision and current authority evidence.

decision_reference.description: Source reference; neither strings nor hashes grant custody or authority.

reference.description: Exact source or material dependency identity.

revision.description: Revision currently expected from this source owner.

decision_actor.description: Semantic actor or explicitly unattributed material. AW context is evidence, not an actor.

kind.description: Admitted semantic actor kind, or unattributed when the source supplies no authorship evidence.

id.description: Stable actor or bounded-answer identity; unattributed material uses a source reference, not a claimed person or agent identity.

decision_authority.description: Deciding authority, distinct from authorship and contribution.

actor.description: The actor supplying the decisive authority.

decision_scope.description: Exact affected identities. No glob or prose matching.

decision_supersedes.description: Explicit scoped replacement by a distinct identity.

scope.description: Superseded subset of both decisions scopes.

material_decision.description: Semantic record. Normalization does not admit its authorship, authority or source custody.

id.description: Stable source-assigned decision identity; not a workspace/view digest.

source.description: Current canonical source admission, separate from material revision.

decision.description: Compact semantic choice authored by agents/humans.

consequence.description: Compact consequence for later applicable work; grants no executable authority.

rationale_reference.description: Source reference for rationale, meaningful alternatives and history.

semantic_routes.description: Shared route identities used only when exact structured scope does not establish relevance. Empty means no semantic fallback.

context.description: Context that informed the choice, including AW owner evidence without AW authorship.

supersedes.description: Explicit prior decisions replaced within scope.

material_revision.description: Rust-derived material revision; when supplied it must match the record.

decision_admission.description: Independent trusted-host admission, not a client declaration. The host must establish provenance and source custody before supplying this binding.

material_revision.description: Exact admitted semantic revision, including deciding authority and provenance.

decision_context.description: Bounded material decisions supplied to the existing compiler. No storage, discovery, execution permissions or authority creation.

reconciliation.description: Optional explicit residue and independently admitted durable dispositions.

records.description: Bounded owner-selected records with complete applicable supersession closure.

applicable_scope.description: Current exact scope selected by host/agent; no semantic inference.

kind.description: Identity namespace for current task binding.

id.description: Opaque current task or Planning identity.

instruction_source_admission.description: Trusted repository host input. The exact admitted snapshot supplies binding scopes; public callers cannot supply it as intention.

parent.description: Exact branch identity; empty selects roots.

after.description: Returned next_after child identity for continuing this same branch.

routes.description: Exact shared leaf identities; no authority-bearing fields.

revision.description: Current digest of the repo-owned route declarations.

routes.description: Agent-selected declared leaf routes; empty for none or unresolved.

task_identity.description: Task identity current when the acting agent made the selection.

source_revision.description: Route declaration revision current when the selection was made.

provenance.description: Selection authority, never a lexical classifier.

authority_effect.description: Ceiling preventing a route from granting effects or claims.

input_schema.description: Self-contained Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema; Rust validates the schema and its instances with external retrieval disabled.

kind.description: Public owner intention discriminator, independent of operation identity.

semantic_revision.description: Admitted operation implementation/recovery semantic revision; independent of package and source view revisions.

reads.description: Complete admitted material read-domain footprint for independence proof. Absent means unknown; an empty array explicitly means no reads. Writes use the declared effect ceiling.

id.description: Globally unique operation identity owned by one capability owner.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema for exact owner-derived operation arguments.

effects.description: Maximum effects this operation may advertise, all owned by the same owner.

claims.description: Claims for which the same owner has exclusive authority.

revision.description: Current semantic revision of this owner declaration.

domains.description: Exclusive domains managed by this owner.

domain.description: One domain declared by the same owner.

requests.description: Public owner intentions, independently declared from operations.

operations.description: Public operations this owner can construct and answer.

revision.description: Current source revision to which public requests bind.

restriction_authorities.description: Trusted admission of exact restriction scopes, independent of claim grants and effect ownership. Task is an explicit scope, not a wildcard. No contribution or implementation descriptor can self-grant these rights.

claim_authorities.description: Exclusive claim-to-owner assignments admitted independently of source contributions.

owner.description: Sole capability owner authorized to grant the claim.

id.description: Caller correlation identity for one bounded request.

owner.description: Capability owner asked to interpret the request.

owner_revision.description: Capability-owner semantic revision current when selected.

source_revision.description: Owner contribution revision current when selected.

capability_revision.description: Capability contract revision current when selected.

task_identity.description: Current work identity when the acting agent or human selected the request.

arguments.description: Arguments admitted by the declared bounded request shape.

dependency_revision.description: Owner-derived revision of material action dependencies, excluding unrelated source changes.

source_requests.description: Exact current source-owner requests retained as invocation dependencies; delivery is not proof or mutation authority.

effect_generation.description: Owner-authorized repeat boundary; absent means the initial logical effect, never ambient revision churn.

response_request.description: Owner request kind and fixed arguments; only the answer slot is human/domain supplied.

request_identity.description: Complete normalized identity returned by the shared request preparation boundary.

consequence_ids.description: Exact current owner consequences answering this request only; empty for a settled response.

status.description: Kind of exact owner response present in this contribution.

decision_source_read_request.description: Select one exact currently returned decision admission for bounded rationale retrieval. These public fields grant no source admission, currentness, custody or executable authority.

memory_note_read_request.description: Read one currently selected advisory Memory note; source identity grants no freshness, promotion or binding authority.

task_judgment_input.description: Internal current owner observations for exact task judgment; no public source or producer authority ingress.

task_requirements_judgment.description: Acting agent task judgment, not policy or Verification authority.

target_scope.description: Current acting-agent applicability judgments for exact configured forbidden task classes. Applies denies the target; not-applicable does not grant capability or override policy. Omitted or unresolved remains blocked. Never durable configuration.

verification_request.description: Optional current public Verification requirements request; the source owner revalidates it before projection. Never a caller-supplied Verification contribution.

task_requirements_input.description: Internal current task, Verification and human-constraint observations; never public authority fields.

anyOf.description: Internal current role-specific Verification owner contribution.

system_intent_read_arguments.description: Exact current owner-selected source read; no interpretation, mutation or acceptance authority.

reference.description: Reference returned by the current source owner.
